title: First-launch setup, walkthrough and limited demo
details: Fresh installs now open with Set up my Evia, Try Evia Demo and Show me around
The demo uses one real Evia course route with a maximum of three evidence submissions, evidence download and one Mock Practical
The full learner route starts with an Evia Course QR, then completes the learner profile with an optional online portfolio link
Existing activated learners bypass the new first-run screen and continue into their current Evia setup
summary: Evia v215 adds the fresh-install demo and QR-activated learner onboarding journey without interrupting existing activated learners.
changes: Added a locally isolated Bricklayer demo course pack with one route and three evidence opportunities
Limited demo assessment access to one Mock Practical and kept evidence download available
Added QR-first learner activation followed by profile setup with optional portfolio URL
Locked course selection in the profile for newly QR-activated learners
Created a fresh v215 offline cache
